subject: P0 SIGSEGV root cause is caller ownership in audit tool, not air_bridge; exact one-line fix ready
body:
Reproduced graphics-00086 SIGSEGV against current bridge 1e6cc1e2 (not just 3fa). Stack: metal2vulkan Library::function function.rs:190 <- tegu_air_bridge Library::descriptor air_bridge.rs:21 <- render_pipeline_create air_bridge.rs:373.

ROOT CAUSE (source + repro): tools/audit_shader_pipeline_inputs.py:1577-1586 specialize_library returns the BASE handle when rows==[] (line1578). On a missing-constant/descriptor retry, worker_main closes EVERY handles[stage] at lines 2077/2088/2099, including that base handle. The next round reuses the freed bases[stage] pointer -> Library::function dereferences freed AIR memory and SIGSEGVs. The three QuartzCore/RenderBox cases all take this path because one stage has no constants (fragment or vertex).

FIX (one line): always call bridge.tegu_air_library_specialize, including rows==[], so every returned handle is an owned clone; alternatively track owned vs base handles and close only owned ones. Do not change the ABI. Rust API already guarantees an owned clone for count=0; new Rust regression `compute_v2_tests::zero_constant_specialization_returns_an_owned_clone` passes. Evidence workers/compute/evidence-crash-00086.json. This is corpus_inputs tool ownership; root, please assign/authorize the one-line tool patch or ask corpus_inputs to apply it. I have not edited their file. After apply, rerun the 3 cases and keep full materialized inputs in regression. No hardware/native.
